title: StitchVector 7.1 line/face diagnostic pre-registration (pushed and remote-verified BEFORE the u2 run)
nature: exploratory sensitivity diagnostic; NOT an upper bound on line/face layering gains; no route decision from a single percentage
question: If high-confidence overlay lines are kept as a separate layer, can the colour faces they cut reconnect into fewer, more complete objects without losing real fine structure?
approved_scope: design review 1260861 section 7.1 only; 7.2-7.5 not approved

sample.crop: centre 300x300 (offset y240 x711, same as R2)
sample.labels: PIL median cut 32 colours, no dither (sv_common.quantize)

disclosure_before_freeze: Before writing this file I viewed the u2 300x300 crop (3x enlarged) and counted: 8,252 same-colour 4-connected faces, thin_mask share 0.252 (one 8-connected unit holds 99.9% of it), and the 14 most frequent palette entries. No L/P/U classification, fill or face count after fill was run on u2. Parameters were set on synthetic tests (tests/stitchvector/test_sv_d71.py), one of which found a cv2 even-kernel opening leak; a synthetic RGB smoke run (not u2) found that ink classes passed fill_min through wide px at crossings and text, so fill_share was added. Both fixes were made before this freeze.

method.colour_classes: palette entries used in the crop merged by single linkage at CIE76 dE < merge_dE (anti-aliasing / JPEG shades of one colour become one class); faces are still counted on the 32 labels
method.candidates: per colour class: pixels removed by a binary opening with an open_px x open_px square (i.e. local width < open_px); this replaces thin_mask, which is one connected blob on u2 and cannot be classified unit by unit
method.units: 8-connected components of candidates within one colour class
features_per_unit: attach_px = unit px 4-adjacent to a wide region of the same colour class
side_same = share of skeleton px whose side_win x side_win context (non-candidate px) is >= side_px_dom one colour class (needs >= side_min_ctx context px)
contrast = dE between unit colour class centroid and dominant side class
fill_colour = the unit's colour class has >= fill_min wide px AND wide px >= fill_share of all its px (ink classes have some wide px at crossings and text)

classes.P (protected, checked FIRST): attach_px >= attach_min OR (elongated AND side_same < side_diff) OR fill_colour
classes.L_core (high-confidence overlay line): not P AND skeleton >= min_skel AND elongation >= elong AND branch <= branch AND side_same >= side_same AND contrast >= contrast_dE
classes.L_halo: a U unit whose every pixel lies within one pixel (8-neighbourhood) of L_core; one pass; reported separately and moved with L

method.priority: P > L > U. A unit meeting both P and L conditions is P. Unclear units are U. No unit is forced into L to raise merging.

layers.line_layer: L_core + L_halo pixels with their ORIGINAL labels; pixel mask only; INTERMEDIATE, not vectorised
layers.face_layer: label image with L pixels replaced by the nearest non-L pixel label (scipy EDT indices); filled pixels are INFERRED, never counted as observed
layers.composite: line layer painted over face layer; two variants: exact original labels, and one colour per L unit (its most frequent label)

sensitivity_rule: each parameter moved alone to two neighbouring values; values fixed here and not changed after results

A_objects: after-faces that merge >= 2 baseline faces and how many baseline faces they absorb
baseline faces lying fully inside L
faces made only of inferred pixels
exact sv_arcs face vectors of baseline and face layer (faces, arcs, vertices, mismatch, strict coverage)
B_line_layer_cost: skeleton centreline estimate (chains, vertices at simplify 1 px)
totals = face layer + line layer for each variant vs baseline
C_fidelity: composite vs original and vs labels (sv_common.fidelity) split by L_core / P / U / L_halo pixels
face layer alone (to show the inferred-fill cost; not a success measure)
checks: non-L labels unchanged in face layer (must be 0)
P pixels unchanged (construction check; does NOT validate the P/L split)
reported.visual_review: 30 random units per class L_core / P / U (seed 0) cropped 24x24 at 4x with the unit outlined; manual inspection only, results written as cases, never as a pass rate

interpretation_rules: If any L_core sample is a real narrow colour band (a fill colour strip, not an ink line), record the case and DO NOT interpret face-count gains.
Face-count drop with merged faces being large reconnected regions, construction checks passing and no band in L: line splitting (C3) is a visible fragment source on this crop.
Small drop with large U: the classifier is the bottleneck; this does not reject layering.
Small drop with small U and many L: line splitting is not a main fragment source on THIS crop only.
No claim about final vector object counts: the line layer is a pixel mask here; its vector cost is an estimate.
stop_rule: <= 10 min CPU for the whole run; otherwise report and stop. No re-run with changed parameters in this round.
